key: My GuIlt Is A PrIson; ItS WaLls ArE My HoMe.
en: My GuIlt Is A PrIson; ItS WaLls ArE My HoMe.
ja: 私のツミは監獄。その壁こそ我が家だ。

key: ThAt ShE's No LoNger In ThIs WoRld Is No FaUlt BuT My OwN.
en: ThAt ShE's No LoNger In ThIs WoRld Is No FaUlt BuT My OwN.
ja: あれがこの世にイないのは、ヒトえに私のセいだ。

key: HaD I NeVer JoIned MeTeor-- WeLl, We'D NeVer HaVe MeT.
en: HaD I NeVer JoIned MeTeor-- WeLl, We'D NeVer HaVe MeT.
ja: メテオだんに入らなければ——ワれらは出会わなかった。

key: BuT ShE'd StIll Be AmOng Us, As ThEre'd Be No ReAl ThReat.
en: BuT ShE'd StIll Be AmOng Us, As ThEre'd Be No ReAl ThReat.
ja: だガあれは今もここにイたはず。真の脅威などナかったのだから。

key: It WaS I WhO UnEarthed It, TwO TiMelines ReMoved:
en: It WaS I WhO UnEarthed It, TwO TiMelines ReMoved:
ja: それをホり起こしたのは私だ、ふたつ前の時のナがれで。

key: A WeApon FoR SoLaris-- HiS PoWers ImProved.
en: A WeApon FoR SoLaris-- HiS PoWers ImProved.
ja: ソラリスのためのブキ——彼の力を高めるために。

key: EaRthquakes WeRe OnE ThIng; ThEy're AlL MoSt ReCall.
en: EaRthquakes WeRe OnE ThIng; ThEy're AlL MoSt ReCall.
ja: 地震はまだシも。皆が覚えているのはソれだけだ。

key: BuT ThE DaNger WaS GrEater-- DiStortion BeAt AlL.
en: BuT ThE DaNger WaS GrEater-- DiStortion BeAt AlL.
ja: だガ危険はもっとオオきかった——ユガみこそ最悪だった。

key: EvEn ThIs StOry Is OnE ThAt ReMains SeCondhand.
en: EvEn ThIs StOry Is OnE ThAt ReMains SeCondhand.
ja: この話サえ、私にはマた聞きにすぎない。

key: ZiNa SeAled OuR MeMories FoR ThE SaKe Of ThIs LaNd.
en: ZiNa SeAled OuR MeMories FoR ThE SaKe Of ThIs LaNd.
ja: ジーナはこの地のためにワれらの記憶をフウじた。

key: I JuSt WaNt HeR BaCk. Is ThAt So MuCh To AsK?
en: I JuSt WaNt HeR BaCk. Is ThAt So MuCh To AsK?
ja: ただアれを取り戻したいだけだ。ソれほど大それた願いか?

key: GARDEVOIR: uNDOING tHE pAST iS nO sIMPLE tASK.
en: GARDEVOIR: uNDOING tHE pAST iS nO sIMPLE tASK.
ja: サーナイト: カコをなかったことにするのは タヤスいことじゃない。

key: bUT yOU cOULD sTILL sTAY wITH mE! i'LL bE aLL yOU nEED!
en: bUT yOU cOULD sTILL sTAY wITH mE! i'LL bE aLL yOU nEED!
ja: でもワタシといればいい! ワタシがぜんぶになるカら!

key: I dON't cARE aBOUT eTHICS; i'M yOURS-- gUARANTEED!
en: I dON't cARE aBOUT eTHICS; i'M yOURS-- gUARANTEED!
ja: リンリなんてどうでもいい。ワタシはあなたのもの——ホショウする!

key: RADOMUS: YoU InSult Me By PrEssing. I WiLl NeVer LoVe YoU.
en: RADOMUS: YoU InSult Me By PrEssing. I WiLl NeVer LoVe YoU.
ja: ラドマス: セマるのは侮辱だ。私がオマえを愛することはない。

key: BuT To FrEe YoU-- To JoIn HeR... PeRhaps I'lL DiSappear ToO.
en: BuT To FrEe YoU-- To JoIn HeR... PeRhaps I'lL DiSappear ToO.
ja: だガおまえをカイほうし、あれのもとへ行くため……私もキえようか。

key: It WoUld Be SiMplest. It CaN EnD In a FlAsh!
en: It WoUld Be SiMplest. It CaN EnD In a FlAsh!
ja: それがイちばん簡単だ。ヒとイきに終わる!

key: GARDEVOIR: dON'T yOU dARE tALK lIKE tHAT! dON'T dO sOMETHING sO rASH!
en: GARDEVOIR: dON'T yOU dARE tALK lIKE tHAT! dON'T dO sOMETHING sO rASH!
ja: サーナイト: ソんなこと言わないで! ムボウな真似はやめて!

key: iT'S tHIS mALIGNANT aURA-- sO dREARY aND gAUCHE!
en: iT'S tHIS mALIGNANT aURA-- sO dREARY aND gAUCHE!
ja: このワルいオーラのせいよ——インキで下品な!

key: bUT pERHAPS yOU cAN hELP uS-- tHIS mALAISE cAN bE bROACHED!
en: bUT pERHAPS yOU cAN hELP uS-- tHIS mALAISE cAN bE bROACHED!
ja: でもアなたなら助けになれる——このヤマいにも切り口はあるはず!

key: RADOMUS: I SuPpose ThE PrEamble HaS EnDed; OvErdue Is ThE FiGht.
en: RADOMUS: I SuPpose ThE PrEamble HaS EnDed; OvErdue Is ThE FiGht.
ja: ラドマス: 前置きは終わりのヨうだ。戦いはトうに遅れている。

key: BuT DeSpite ThE BoArd AnD OuR MoTes, ThIs Is NoT BlAck AnD WhIte.
en: BuT DeSpite ThE BoArd AnD OuR MoTes, ThIs Is NoT BlAck AnD WhIte.
ja: だガ盤とチリにもかかわらず、これは白黒では割り切れない。

key: RADOMUS: I SuPpose I Am Too quIck To let go of the responsibilities I'd leave behind here.
en: RADOMUS: I SuPpose I Am Too quIck To let go of the responsibilities I'd leave behind here.
ja: ラドムス: ワタシハ　ココニ　ノコス　セキニンヲ　テバナスノガ　ハヤスギタ　ヨウダ

key: GARDEVOIR: mUCH aS i mIgHT pRefeR tO hAve you all to myself, we can't quite call it curtains yet.
en: GARDEVOIR: mUCH aS i mIgHT pRefeR tO hAve you all to myself, we can't quite call it curtains yet.
ja: サーナイト: アナタをヒとりジめしたいのはヤマヤマだけど、まだ幕を下ろすわけにはいかないわね。

key: RADOMUS: To be given to neglect my duties yet again is beyond shameful.
en: RADOMUS: To be given to neglect my duties yet again is beyond shameful.
ja: ラドマス: またしても職務を怠るとは　恥ずべきことだ。

key: But I won't waste words on self pity.
en: But I won't waste words on self pity.
ja: だが、自分をあわれむことに言葉を費やすつもりはない。

key: Where is Anna?
en: Where is Anna?
ja: アンナはどこにいる?

key: ...She should have vanished entirely, you say?
en: ...She should have vanished entirely, you say?
ja: ……完全に消えたはずだと?

key: And I can guess that only those closest to her even remember her to know that anything is wrong.
en: And I can guess that only those closest to her even remember her to know that anything is wrong.
ja: そして、彼女をよく知る者だけが　彼女を覚えていて　異変に気づけるのだろうな。

key: But if she's still... able to do this...
en: But if she's still... able to do this...
ja: だが、まだ……こんなことができるのなら……

key: Perhaps it's not entirely too late.
en: Perhaps it's not entirely too late.
ja: 手遅れとは限らないかもしれない。

key: Even if I let it happen a second time...
en: Even if I let it happen a second time...
ja: たとえ　二度目を許してしまったとしても……

key: ...I truly wish to take my myriad regrets and bury them with me where no one can find us ever again,
en: ...I truly wish to take my myriad regrets and bury them with me where no one can find us ever again,
ja: ……無数の悔いを抱えたまま、誰にも見つからない場所へ　共に埋もれてしまいたい。

key: But if the Dreamsickness hasn't taken her entirely yet, I must hurry.
en: But if the Dreamsickness hasn't taken her entirely yet, I must hurry.
ja: だが、ゆめやみがまだ彼女を完全に奪っていないのなら、急がねば。

key: ...And to disappear now would do Noel no favors.
en: ...And to disappear now would do Noel no favors.
ja: ……それに、今消えては　ノエルのためにならない。

key: He must feel I've abandoned him again.
en: He must feel I've abandoned him again.
ja: また見捨てられたと　あの子は思っているだろう。

key: Just asleep?
en: Just asleep?
ja: ただ眠っているだけ、と?

key: Even unendingly--
en: Even unendingly--
ja: 終わりなく、であっても——

key: Then the Dreamsickness hasn't taken her entirely yet.
en: Then the Dreamsickness hasn't taken her entirely yet.
ja: ならば　ゆめやみはまだ彼女を完全には奪っていない。

key: But I must hurry.
en: But I must hurry.
ja: だが、急がねばならない。

key: And Noel must feel I've abandoned him again.
en: And Noel must feel I've abandoned him again.
ja: そしてノエルは　また見捨てられたと思っているだろう。

key: GARDEVOIR: I'll explain all that, if you'll afford me the chance.
en: GARDEVOIR: I'll explain all that, if you'll afford me the chance.
ja: サーナイト: 機会をいただけるなら、すべてご説明します。

key: It was my power that took you away.
en: It was my power that took you away.
ja: あなたを連れ去ったのは　わたしの力です。

key: A power that I only ever intended to protect you with...
en: A power that I only ever intended to protect you with...
ja: あなたを守るためだけに使うつもりだった力……

key: But the machines had other plans; I felt as if they had erased my capacity for conscious thought altogether.
en: But the machines had other plans; I felt as if they had erased my capacity for conscious thought altogether.
ja: でも機械はそうさせてくれなかった。まるで　わたしの意識そのものを消し去られたようでした。

key: I heard you trying to reach out to me in Victory Road.
en: I heard you trying to reach out to me in Victory Road.
ja: チャンピオンロードで　あなたが呼びかけてくれたのは聞こえていました。

key: I was... touched, but...
en: I was... touched, but...
ja: うれしかった……でも……

key: All I could feel at the time was a great, numbing anger.
en: All I could feel at the time was a great, numbing anger.
ja: あのとき感じられたのは　しびれるような大きな怒りだけでした。

key: ...No, I suppose even then, I was simply envious.
en: ...No, I suppose even then, I was simply envious.
ja: ……いいえ、あのときも　ただうらやんでいただけかもしれません。

key: But I am quite myself again, thanks in large part to \PN.
en: But I am quite myself again, thanks in large part to \PN.
ja: でも　もうすっかり元どおりです。\PNのおかげが大きい。

key: I will make sure Noel knows you did not leave him by choice.
en: I will make sure Noel knows you did not leave him by choice.
ja: あなたが望んで去ったのではないと　ノエルにきちんと伝えます。

key: RADOMUS: Not this time.
en: RADOMUS: Not this time.
ja: ラドマス: 今回は、な。

key: But I feel that I owe you apologies as well.
en: But I feel that I owe you apologies as well.
ja: だが、きみにも　あやまらねばならないと思う。

key: GARDEVOIR: Nope, I have no need of them!
en: GARDEVOIR: Nope, I have no need of them!
ja: サーナイト: いいえ、そんなものは必要ありません!

key: I do not want them, and you cannot make me accept them!
en: I do not want them, and you cannot make me accept them!
ja: 受け取りたくありませんし、受け取らせることもできません!

key: I am well aware that my feelings are a reflection of your grief.
en: I am well aware that my feelings are a reflection of your grief.
ja: わたしの感情が　あなたの悲しみの映しであることは　よく分かっています。

key: But as your partner, I do not permit you to take responsibility for my emotions.
en: But as your partner, I do not permit you to take responsibility for my emotions.
ja: けれど相棒として、わたしの感情の責任をあなたが負うことは許しません。

key: They are my problem, and I will deal with them and serve by your side as I always have.
en: They are my problem, and I will deal with them and serve by your side as I always have.
ja: これはわたしの問題。自分で向き合い、これまでどおりあなたのそばで仕えます。

key: There will be no further discussion on the matter.
en: There will be no further discussion on the matter.
ja: この件について　これ以上の議論はありません。

key: You have a son to look after and a cure to research!
en: You have a son to look after and a cure to research!
ja: あなたには　見守るべき息子と　研究すべき治療法があるのですから!

key: And for that matter, I'm sure I have no shortage of news to catch up on.
en: And for that matter, I'm sure I have no shortage of news to catch up on.
ja: それに　わたしにも　追いかけるべきニュースが山ほどあるはずです。

key: If I slack off for too long then the next thing I know, the network will replace me with some cheap knock-off.
en: If I slack off for too long then the next thing I know, the network will replace me with some cheap knock-off.
ja: 長く怠けていたら、気づいたときには局が安物の偽者に　わたしを差し替えているでしょう。

key: "Mystery Mismagius" or "Rumor Roserade" or some other miserable alliterative mistake such as that.
en: "Mystery Mismagius" or "Rumor Roserade" or some other miserable alliterative mistake such as that.
ja: 「ミステリー・ムウマージ」だとか「ルーモア・ロズレイド」だとか、そんな惨めな頭韻の失敗作に。

key: In fact, I do believe I should head there now to make sure they are not brewing felonies even as we speak.
en: In fact, I do believe I should head there now to make sure they are not brewing felonies even as we speak.
ja: いえ、こうしている今も　悪だくみをしていないか　すぐ確かめに行くべきですね。

key: Let us be off!
en: Let us be off!
ja: さあ、参りましょう!

key: RADOMUS: \PN, if you're going right back to the city, do you want us to just teleport you there?
en: RADOMUS: \PN, if you're going right back to the city, do you want us to just teleport you there?
ja: ラドマス: \PN、このまま街へ戻るなら　テレポートで送ろうか?

key: RADOMUS: Then let us be off at once.
en: RADOMUS: Then let us be off at once.
ja: ラドマス: では　すぐに発つとしよう。

key: For another countless time, we owe you much thanks.
en: For another countless time, we owe you much thanks.
ja: 数えきれぬほど　またきみに助けられた。心から感謝する。

key: Until our paths cross again.
en: Until our paths cross again.
ja: また道が交わる日まで。

key: GARDEVOIR: Suit yourself.
en: GARDEVOIR: Suit yourself.
ja: サーナイト: お好きなように。

key: RADOMUS: For another countless time, we owe you much thanks.
en: RADOMUS: For another countless time, we owe you much thanks.
ja: ラドマス: 数えきれぬほど　またきみに助けられた。心から感謝する。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
